properties.name: Baalbek
properties.description: Temple complex with the largest stone blocks ever quarried (1,000+ tons). Temple of Jupiter Baal ranks among the grandest Roman temples.

properties.name: Byblos (Jbeil)
properties.description: One of the world's oldest continuously inhabited cities. Sacred to Astarte and Adonis. The word 'Bible' derives from Byblos (Greek for 'book').

properties.name: Petra — City of the Nabataeans
properties.description: City carved from rose-red sandstone by the Nabataeans. Al-Khazneh (Treasury) may be a royal tomb. High Place of Sacrifice offers mountain-top rituals.
properties.modernStatus: UNESCO World Heritage Site, New Seven Wonders of the World
